'''DarthVader,AOE Rescue The Princess - PLAYERS PRECONSTRUCT 4 Classic''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader,AOE]]
* '''Published:''' 18 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 RTP DarthVader,AOE LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Finally completed! Rescue The Princess Classic Format Deck created by the members of GPN.

The published list has 64 cards.
